data.desc: Tempest is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing a pipeline of advanced in vivo CAR-T therapies designed to treat cancer and autoimmune disease by resetting dysfunctional immunity. Tempest's portfolio includes TPST-4903, a BCMA/GPRC5D dual-targeting in vivo CAR-T candidate being evaluated in a Phase 1 study for relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma (rrMM). The Company's lead lipid nanoparticle (LNP)-based in vivo CAR-T candidate, TPST-4003 combines a clinically supported dual-targeting CD19/BCMA CAR structure with an advanced CD7-targeting delivery platform to support broad immune reset across multiple indications. The company's additional preclinical programs leverage advanced payloads to create a modular in vivo CAR-T portfolio. Tempest envisions a world in which immune reset therapies bring safe, effective, and broadly accessible therapeutic options to patients in need.
